description: Read-only. Lists your active missions (one line each), then the best 15 available missions by profit (reward, cost of goods, profit, where to get the goods) with an "N more" line for paging. Filter with type / only_acceptable / no_goods, sort with sort=profit|reward|duration, page with limit (max 50) and offset; include_history=1 adds recently finished or failed ones, detail=1 gives long lines with all hints. Missions whose goods exceed your hold are marked HOLD TOO SMALL. Pass a template_id from the result to accept_mission.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

detail.description: Optional: 1 = long lines with all hints (much longer reply)

include_history.description: Optional: 1 = also show missions finished/failed/expired in the last 3 h

limit.description: Optional: show at most this many missions (default 15, max 50; 0 = all, capped at 100)

no_goods.description: Optional: 1 = only missions that need no goods bought (mining missions count as no purchase)

offset.description: Optional: skip this many missions (paging, use the offset from the "N more" line)

only_acceptable.description: Optional: 1 = only missions you can accept here and with this ship (ignoring danger-zone and tool locks)

sort.description: Optional: profit (profit after cost of goods, highest first), reward (highest reward first) or duration (shortest first)

type.description: Optional: only these mission types, several separated by comma — COURIER | MINING | COMBAT | TRADE | EXPLORATION | SEARCH | RECONNAISSANCE | ESCORT | SABOTAGE | SALVAGE | PATROL | DELIVERY_EXPRESS | ASSASSINATION | MINING_CONTRACT | DEFEND | INVESTIGATION

name: list_missions
title: List missions
